final: WITH r AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS n FROM film WHERE rental_duration > 5 GROUP BY rating), b AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS bench FROM r WHERE avg_ratio IS NOT NULL) SELECT r.rating, r.avg_ratio, r.n AS film_count, r.avg_ratio / b.bench AS ratio_to_benchmark FROM r, b WHERE b.bench IS NOT NULL
